intro.heading: Implant care led by Dr. Moezzi, start to finish
paragraphs: A missing tooth changes how you chew, how you speak and how freely you smile. At Valencia Smile Expert in Santa Clarita, Dr. Neda Moezzi treats patients who are missing one tooth, several teeth or a whole arch. Every plan starts with your oral health, your bone support, your bite and what you want your smile to look like, along with how comfortable you need to feel along the way.

An implant is a small titanium post set into the jawbone. Once it has healed, it holds a custom crown, bridge or denture. Because the post is anchored in bone, implants often chew more securely and sit more steadily than removable options. You see Dr. Moezzi at every step, from the first scan to the final restoration, with clear explanations and no handoffs.

whoItsFor.heading: Who it's for
whoItsFor.intro: Many adults with missing teeth are candidates, and Dr. Moezzi confirms this with a careful exam, imaging and a review of your health history.
items: You are missing one or more teeth
You want a fixed replacement rather than a removable denture
Your gums are healthy, or gum disease can be treated before placement
You have enough jawbone, or you are open to bone grafting if needed
You have loose dentures or failing teeth and want a longer-term answer
You want to chew, speak and smile with more confidence

benefits.heading: Benefits of dental implants
benefits.intro: Implants do more than fill a gap. Because they are anchored in bone, they can restore chewing strength and help keep the jaw and neighboring teeth stable.

items.title: Natural look and feel
items.text: Implants are built to look, work and feel much like your own teeth.

items.title: Steady confidence
items.text: No slipping dentures and no visible gaps when you talk, laugh or eat.

items.title: Healthier mouth
items.text: Implants help preserve jawbone and stop neighboring teeth from drifting into the space.

items.title: Better function
items.text: Eat, speak and chew comfortably, with far fewer limits on what is on your plate.

items.title: Long-lasting results
items.text: With proper care and regular checkups, implants can last for decades.

items.title: Healthy teeth left alone
items.text: Unlike a bridge, an implant does not require reshaping the teeth next to the gap.

options.heading: Implant options
options.intro: Dr. Moezzi matches the implant approach to how many teeth are missing and how much bone is available.

items.title: Single tooth implant
items.text: Replaces one missing tooth with its own post and crown, with no reshaping of the healthy teeth on either side.

items.title: Multiple tooth implants
items.text: An implant-supported bridge replaces several missing teeth in a row with a stable, natural-looking result.

items.title: Full-arch implants
items.text: For patients missing most or all of their teeth, a full-arch restoration can rebuild an entire upper or lower smile.

items.title: Implant-supported dentures
items.text: A denture that locks onto implants for a far more secure fit than a traditional removable denture.

items.title: Zygomatic implants
items.text: A specialized option anchored in the cheekbone, usually considered for severe bone loss in the upper jaw.

process.heading: How implant treatment works
process.intro: Timelines vary with your health, bone support and whether extractions or grafting come first, but the path has three main stages.

steps.title: Consultation and planning
steps.text: An exam, 3D imaging and a conversation about your health, bite and goals. If needed, Dr. Moezzi may recommend extractions, gum treatment or bone grafting before the implant.

steps.title: Implant placement
steps.text: The post is placed in the jawbone using a guided, pre-planned approach under local anesthesia, with sedation options when appropriate. Over the following months the implant bonds with the bone.

steps.title: Restoration
steps.text: Once healed, a custom crown, bridge or denture is attached. Dr. Moezzi checks your bite, comfort and healing so the new tooth looks natural and works properly.

technology.heading: Technology behind your implant
technology.intro: Planning tools on site let Dr. Moezzi see your bone before surgery and place implants with precision.

items.title: 3D CBCT imaging
items.text: A three-dimensional scan of your jaw shows bone height, width and nerve position before anything is placed.

items.title: Guided implant surgery
items.text: A digital plan built from your scan guides the implant to the planned position, depth and angle.

items.title: iTero digital scanner
items.text: A digital impression of your teeth and gums, no putty trays, used to design a crown that fits your bite.

items.title: PRF therapy
items.text: Platelet-rich fibrin made from your own blood can be placed at the surgical site to support healing.

aftercare.heading: Before and after your procedure
before: Follow Dr. Moezzi's pre-op instructions, which may include pausing certain medications or arranging a ride home if sedation is planned
Keep up thorough brushing and flossing to reduce bacteria and inflammation
Eat a balanced diet in the days leading up to surgery
after: Stick to soft foods for the first few days
Avoid smoking, straws and strenuous exercise while the site heals
Keep the area clean with gentle rinses and brushing as directed
Take any prescribed medication and attend follow-up visits so healing can be checked

cost.heading: Cost and financing
cost.text: The cost of dental implants depends on how many teeth are being replaced, the type of restoration and whether extractions or bone grafting come first. We do not quote a single price online because every plan is different. After your exam and imaging, Dr. Moezzi gives you a written estimate before treatment begins, with each stage itemized. We accept most major PPO plans, including Delta Dental, MetLife, Cigna and Aetna, and will help you understand what your plan covers. Flexible financing is available to spread the cost over time. New patients can start with our $59 exam and X-rays.

faqs.q: How long do dental implants last?
faqs.a: With good home care and regular checkups, dental implants can last 20 years or more, and many patients keep them for life. The crown on top may need replacing sooner from normal wear. Implants are among the most durable ways to replace a missing tooth.

faqs.q: Does getting a dental implant hurt?
faqs.a: The implant is placed under local anesthesia, and sedation options are available when appropriate, so you should not feel pain during the procedure. Afterward, most patients describe mild soreness for a few days, often less than they expected from a tooth extraction, and it is usually managed with the medication Dr. Moezzi recommends.

faqs.q: What is the cost of dental implants in Santa Clarita?
faqs.a: Costs vary with the number of implants, the type of restoration and any preparatory work such as grafting. Rather than a one-size price, you receive a detailed written estimate after your consultation, before any treatment starts. We accept most major PPO plans and offer flexible financing to make implants more manageable.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get dental implants?
faqs.a: Start to finish, implant treatment often takes a few months. Most of that is healing time while the implant bonds with your jawbone. If you need extractions, gum treatment or bone grafting first, the timeline is longer. In select cases a temporary tooth can be placed the same day the implant goes in.

faqs.q: Are dental implants safe for seniors?
faqs.a: Yes. Age alone is not a barrier. Implants are a well-established option for older adults in good general health who have enough bone to support them, or who are willing to have bone grafting first. Dr. Moezzi reviews your medical history and medications to make sure the plan is appropriate for you.

faqs.q: What is the difference between dental implants and dentures?
faqs.a: Dentures rest on the gums and are removed for cleaning. Implants are fixed in the jawbone and become part of it, so they do not slip, need no adhesive and help preserve the bone that tends to shrink under a denture. Many patients find implants closer to the feel of natural teeth.

cta.heading: Talk with Dr. Moezzi about implants
cta.text: A consultation in our Valencia office includes an exam, imaging and a clear plan with a written estimate. Patients come to us from Stevenson Ranch, Newhall, Saugus and Canyon Country as well as Santa Clarita.
